results_section.claim: 1. UDCA achieves a PCE of ≈1.5 versus 6.4 (static) and 0.3 (passive).
results_section.explanation: Execution stage: The experiment has no fixed random seed, so the exact triple (6.4, 1.5, 0.3) cannot be reproduced deterministically. Across 200 seeded runs, UDCA mean (~1.43) matches the paper's '≈1.5' closely, passive median (~0.38) is close to the claimed 0.3, and static 6.4 is within the observed distribution (p75=7.7). The expected ordering (passive<udca<static) holds 84% of the time, supporting the qualitative finding. However, the specific combination cannot be definitively verified without knowing the original seed, and static=6.4 is substantially above the median. No fabrication is evident — values are plausible outcomes of the stochastic simulation.
